technical_and_design_decisions: Use Go standard library and existing Hyperledger Fabric protobuf definitions for underlying configuration structure management.
Implement fluent API sub-types (e.g., Application, Channel, Orderer, Org) as light wrappers over underlying protobuf config groups to support method chaining.
Extract Orderer configuration types into a dedicated `pkg/configtx/orderer` subpackage and MSP configuration types into `pkg/configtx/membership` subpackage.
Refactor `SetXXX` behavior to perform upsert operations (overwrite existing map/slice entries without throwing errors when items exist).
Refactor `RemoveXXX` methods to be idempotent, returning no errors when attempting to delete non-existent values.

Build the CLI tool using a standard Go CLI framework (such as Cobra or standard `flag`/`os.Args`) under `cmd/configtx` to support genesis block, channel tx generation, and subcommands for config updates.
assumptions: The developer is familiar with Go, Protobuf, Hyperledger Fabric internals, and godoc formatting rules.
Existing unit tests exist in `pkg/configtx` and will need refactoring to reflect the updated function signatures and behavior.
No breaking protocol-level protobuf change is required; changes are confined to the high-level Go SDK/API surface in `pkg/configtx`.

activities.activity_name: Refactor Set and Remove Semantics (U1 & U6)
activities.activity_description: Convert all `AddXXX` and `UpdateXXX` functions to `SetXXX` with upsert/overwrite behavior (handling slices like `SetAnchorPeer` to prevent duplicates). Update `RemoveXXX` functions to be idempotent and return no error when non-existent items are removed. Update unit tests for these mutators.

Create `orderer` and `membership` subpackages within `configtx`. Move Orderer types (Kafka, EtcdRaft, BatchSize, ConsensusState) and MSP types (SigningIdentityInfo, OUIdentifier, CryptoConfig, NodeOUs) into their respective packages. Update internal references and GoDocs.

activities.activity_name: API Renaming and Method Chaining Implementation (U2 & U3)
activities.activity_description: Rename `Base()` to `BaseConfig()` and `Updated()` to `UpdatedConfig()`. Design and implement sub-type wrapper structs (e.g., Application, Orderer, Org) to enable chained calls like `c.Application().Org(orgName).SetAnchorPeer(...)`. Update tests for API chaining.

Enhance documentation for `New()`. Remove unnecessary capability/MSP examples and output validation comments. Rename and split example functions into focused examples (e.g., `Example_textExample`, `Example_policyRetrieval`, `Example_ordererUpdate`). Fix linebreaks to prevent horizontal scrolling in godoc output.

Create the `configtx` CLI application capable of generating system channel genesis blocks, application channel creation transactions, and config update transactions via subcommands and flags (e.g., `configtx update addAnchorPeer`). Include CLI documentation and help command support.
Execute full package test suite, verify CLI binary execution against sample configurations, and inspect locally generated godoc web pages (`godoc -http=:2020`) for proper rendering and formatting.
